transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having these mornings where I think… it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself, but the thoughts scared me enough that I thought I should ask for help.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yes. I still go to things, like my book club or the dance night, because I feel like I should. But lately I’m just… there. It feels like I’m watching it from behind a pane of glass. Even my garden, and cooking for the neighbors, they don’t give me that little lift they used to.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I do feel low a lot, but I haven’t been keeping track of whether it’s most of the day or nearly every day.
Would you say that you feel down or depressed nearly every day, even if it's not all day?
I think… probably, yes. Not every minute of the day, but most days I do have that low feeling at some point.
Can you clarify whether on most days you feel down or depressed for most of the day, or if it comes and goes more randomly throughout the day?

I’m not completely sure. I’d say it comes and goes more than being one solid thing all day. Some days it hangs around for a long stretch, but I haven’t really kept track closely enough to say it’s most of the day on most days.
Can you recall if there have been days when you felt down or depressed for most of the day, and if so, how often has that happened recently?

I can remember some days like that, yes, where it felt like it was with me for a good part of the day. But I honestly couldn’t say how often recently. It hasn’t been something I’ve tracked, so I don’t want to guess too specifically.
Looking back over the last couple of weeks, would you say there were more days than not where you felt down or depressed for most of the day?

I’m not sure I can say “more days than not.” I know there were some days where it lasted a good part of the day, but looking back over the whole two weeks, I didn’t keep track closely enough to answer that confidently.
Have you noticed that you've been feeling more tired or lacking in energy lately, and if so, has that been happening nearly every day?

Yes, I have noticed that. I get worn out more easily than I used to. Even simple errands, or just getting papers together for the Cultural Center, can leave me feeling like I’m moving through thick mud. I’m not sure if it’s nearly every single day, but it’s been happening a lot lately.
Can you tell me if, on most days lately, you’ve felt down or depressed for the majority of the day, even if it’s not constant throughout the entire day?
I’m still not really sure. I know I’ve had stretches during the day where I felt down, but I can’t say clearly that it’s been most days or most of the day. I haven’t been keeping track that closely.
Can you tell me if, over the past two weeks, there have been more days than not when you felt down or depressed for most of the day, even if not the entire day?

I still can’t say for sure. I’ve had some down periods over the last couple of weeks, but whether it was more days than not and most of the day… I just don’t know. I don’t want to guess and give you the wrong answer.
